recordedLimit.error: SHIFT_EXCEEDS_RELEASE: a tail shift of -3 cannot be absorbed by a release of 2 frames; the window would not be the declared one
recordedLimit.note: a train whose release is smaller than the shift tolerance cannot carry a negative phase window. The adapter refuses it by name rather than silently shortening the window; this is why T2b runs at shiftTolerance 0.
